before.title: Vaxleukin-15 (recombinant canine IL-15) for canine mammary tumors
before.center: Vaxcell Bio / Yuhan distribution through veterinary hospitals
before.status: Approved and commercially available in South Korea
before.notes: Vaxleukin-15 (recombinant canine IL-15) is an approved veterinary immunoadjuvant treatment in South Korea. For canine mammary tumors, the approved use is in combination with surgical standard-of-care treatment, not as a replacement for surgery. The mammary-tumor indication was approved in 2024. Current 2026 company materials state that the product is being sold in South Korea through Yuhan. This is treatment access, not an actively recruiting clinical trial.
before.funding: The current public product/program page does not state participant funding or owner costs; confirm with the enrolling veterinary hospital.

after.title: Vaxleukin-15 (canine IL-15) as an adjunct for canine mammary tumors or lymphoma
after.center: Vaxcell Bio / Yuhan distribution through veterinary hospitals
after.status: Approved and commercially available in South Korea
after.notes: Approved commercial veterinary immunoadjuvant treatment in South Korea, not a recruiting trial. The official manufacturer product information states mammary-tumor use with surgical standard care and lymphoma use with chemotherapy. Mammary surgery may already have been performed or be planned; it is not a requirement for lymphoma. The product is for dogs; feline indications are still planned. Public information does not specify owner prices or study funding. A prescribing veterinarian must confirm diagnosis, suitability and the treatment plan.
after.funding: The current public product/program page does not state participant funding or owner costs; confirm with the enrolling veterinary hospital.
after.contacts: Vaxcell Bio / Yuhan: use the official Vaxleukin-15 product page and prescription-clinic finder to locate a South Korean prescribing veterinarian.
